answer: Each identity files an extension to the reef commons, locking 70 credits to its key. It must extend a relic entry and pass a prism check splitting its claim in facets. A failed facet triggers a ripple audit of citing extensions. Each fake needs an extension: 40 work, 70 at risk, 110 total; the thousandth pays 110, so 1,000 cost 110,000. A rented extension fails: it must extend the renter's relic entry with its signature, while a rented copy's chain points away and its bond burns. Anyone can re-check hash, facets, and signature; an honest agent pays once and recovers it after a clean epoch.
